false_stream_policy: dataset order; minus then plus; full CMRG streams 1 through 16
truth_policy: reuse saved historical P11 beta, lambda and penalty RNG state
independent_solver: SciPy linprog highs-ds; explicit primal LP; coefficient block unrestricted
objective_certification: exact saved binary64 X, y-alpha*D, lambda and beta; tau interpreted as 9/10
accuracy_envelope: reuse Stage2C-S frozen eta; both exact certified gaps must be <= eta*n*max(IQR(y*),unscaled MAD(y*),1)
classification: A: both qualified and both layers agree; B: both qualified and at least one layer disagrees; C: unavailable certification or at least one bound exceeds frozen envelope
stop: exactly 24 paired problems; preserve inconclusive/failure cases; no sample replacement, Monte Carlo or Stage2C continuation
